goal: Finish the S9 preflight extraction that CONTEXT.md:215 says runtime/unattended/ already owns exclusively: move the reuse/expiry decision, the BatchAuthorizationBinding construction, and the post-gate claim/drift cascade out of runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts and .pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts into runtime/unattended/, so both adapters become callers only.

acceptance.assertion: runtime/claude/kernel_ports.ts and .pi-extension/imm-unattended-batch.ts call one function exported from runtime/unattended/ for: the reuse/expiry decision (isExistingExpired, expiresAt, reuseBlockers, reuseAuthorization), the BatchAuthorizationBinding construction, and the post-gate claim/drift cascade. Neither adapter recomputes isExistingExpired, reuseBlockers, or the claim locally, and neither recomputes the claim twice within its own call.

batch_preflight.ts's BatchDriftProjection fields active_claim_task_id, own_claim, and plan_unavailable_reason are, after the extraction, either consumed by both adapters (replacing their local recomputation) or removed from BatchDriftProjection because nothing consumes them.
